additions: None of the real style guide's quote instances set `author` (only `authorDescription`), even though several are headlined "Two Authors" — per QuoteImpl/BlogAuthor, a blank author makes quoteModel.author null, so __name/__author-description (both guarded on author.name) never render on any live instance.

Added a left-aligned and a center-aligned instance, each with a plain-string `author` (no DAM asset/Content Fragment needed — BlogAuthor(String) just sets name) plus authorDescription, so QT-010 can check the name/description alignment claim against real rendered content.

Does NOT cover the author-image alignment sub-claim — that needs author.imagePath, which only populates from a real Content Fragment resource (author starting with "/content"), a heavier setup left for a future fixture if that specific sub-claim needs verifying.
